name: capell-app/widget-data-chart
description: Figures you type in become a bar, line or donut chart on your page, with a full table of the numbers underneath.

marketplace.summary: Bar, line and donut charts from typed figures, drawn in your site's main colour with patterns and a table of every value.
marketplace.description: Type your figures into the form and they appear on the page as a bar, line or donut chart. A chart takes one to eight sets of up to fifty labelled numbers each, and bars can dip below zero. Donuts refuse negative figures before you save. Charts use your site's main colour, with patterns on bars and slices and a different dash for each line, so they still read in black and white. Hovering shows an exact value, and a table of every number opens underneath. It needs Layout Builder to place it on a page.
marketplace.problem: A table of figures feels flat, and outside chart tools mean spreadsheets and extra accounts.
marketplace.outcome: Visitors see your figures as a clear chart and can open a table to quote any exact number.

faq.question: Which kinds of chart can I make?
faq.answer: Bar, line or donut. Bars can go below zero to show a loss, but a donut cannot show negative figures and the form tells you before you save.

faq.question: Does the chart update from a spreadsheet?
faq.answer: No. You type the numbers in, and nothing updates on its own.

faq.question: How much data fits in one chart?
faq.answer: Up to eight sets of figures, with up to fifty numbers in each.

faq.question: Can I choose the chart colours?
faq.answer: No. Charts follow your site's main brand colour, and bars, slices and lines are told apart by pattern, so a black and white printout still reads.

faq.question: Can visitors see the exact numbers?
faq.answer: Yes. Hovering over a bar or slice shows its value, and a Chart data heading under the chart opens a table of every label and number.
